# cozystack_tenant (Data Source)

Read an existing Cozystack tenant by name and parent namespace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cozystack_tenant" "root" {
  name      = "root"
  namespace = "tenant-root"
}

output "root_tenant_namespace" {
  value = data.cozystack_tenant.root.status_namespace
}

# Null while the tenant leaves the decision to the platform.
output "root_tenant_gateway" {
  value = data.cozystack_tenant.root.gateway
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tenant name (`metadata.name`).
- `namespace` (String) Parent tenant namespace.

### Read-Only

- `etcd` (Boolean) Whether a dedicated etcd cluster is deployed.
- `gateway` (Boolean) Whether a dedicated Gateway API controller is deployed.
- `host` (String) Hostname used to access tenant services.
- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier `namespace/name`.
- `ingress` (Boolean) Whether a dedicated ingress controller is deployed.
- `monitoring` (Boolean) Whether a dedicated monitoring stack is deployed.
- `ready` (Boolean) Whether the tenant's `Ready` condition is true.
- `resource_quotas` (Map of String) Resource quotas for the tenant, as quantity strings.
- `scheduling_class` (String) Name of the applied SchedulingClass CR.
- `seaweedfs` (Boolean) Whether a dedicated SeaweedFS instance is deployed.
- `status_namespace` (String) Namespace created for the tenant.
- `uid` (String) Server-assigned object UID (`metadata.uid`).
- `version` (String) Deployed chart version.
